notes.title: Cyber Attack - Languages Update (v0.5)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback regarding the operation of the virus system.

[b]Version 0.5[/b]:
- new languages
- redesigned viruses system (now you have the ability to upgrade and control your viruses)
- reduced hacking time to 32 seconds
- new hacking UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/3ac70207e7ee3a2e932e22c1cd73f41fac0cffe2.png[/img]

Languages currently available in Cyber Attack:
- English
- Dutch (99%)
- French (99%)
- German (99%)
- Polish (99%)

Translation of other languages:
- Russian (85%)
- Ukrainian (63%)
- Hungarian (35%)
- Italian (31%)
- Turkish (11%)
- Spanish (5%)

If you want to help with translation visit this website:
[url=https://www.localizor.com/cyber-attack]https://www.localizor.com/cyber-attack[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/dab930b75f7ddb0952c4beb10cf6e464c15af792.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyber Attack - Viruses Update (v0.4)
notes.notes:
[b]Version 0.4[/b] - Viruses Update:

[u]THIEF[/u] - Steal personal data and money,

[u]CIPHER[/u] - Block devices and take a ransom for unlocking.

[u]JAMMER[/u] - Activate to make it difficult for other hackers to detect your attacks.

[u]GLOMAL MINER[/u] - Dig CA COINS on infected devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/ab211f0a84d66c39b570e2b001c5adda6d42f94a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cyber Attack - Cyber Update (v0.2)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/c64272dd5c1967e7c5af39f112415835d3a770d0.png[/img]
